title: Pelagic Blue | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, soaring 18-foot ceilings and curated high-end furnishings set the tone for a stay rooted in comfort and elegance. Three separate living areas offer room to relax and reconnect, while thoughtful touches—like ensuite bathrooms in every king suite, a wet bar for effortless entertaining, and oversized TVs throughout—add to the elevated experience. Premium linens, spa-grade bath products, and seamless indoor-outdoor living bring hotel-level luxury to a home crafted for making memories. Set just steps from Stinky’s Fish Camp and the best of 30A, The Pelagic Blue is a rare offering where space, location, and design come together for an unforgettable coastal escape. The Pelagic Blue rises above the shoreline as one of the most expansive and luxurious beachfront homes on the west end of 30A. Spanning 5,800 square feet with seven spacious bedrooms and seven and a half bathrooms, this three-story retreat was built for gathering in style. Gulf-front living reaches new heights with panoramic views, direct beach access via a private boardwalk, and 100 feet of exclusive shoreline. Whether lounging by the private pool, grilling beneath the pergola, or soaking in the view from one of three Gulf-facing balconies, every space is designed to celebrate the beauty of the coast.
